description: Source code for DeviceIdentityStore class which manages device identity information including loading, generating, signing, verifying, and storing device identity data in a Kotlin Android application.

classes.name: DeviceIdentity
classes.description: Data class representing the device identity, including device ID, public key, private key, and creation timestamp.

classes.name: DeviceIdentityStore
classes.description: Class responsible for managing device identity lifecycle: loading, creating, signing payloads, verifying signatures, and persistently storing identity data.

methods.name: loadOrCreate
methods.description: Loads existing device identity or creates a new one if none exists.

methods.name: signPayload
methods.description: Signs a payload string using the private key associated with a device identity.

methods.name: verifySelfSignature
methods.description: Verifies a signature on a payload using the public key from the device identity.

methods.name: publicKeyBase64Url
methods.description: Returns the device's public key in URL-safe Base64 encoding.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads the device identity from persistent storage.

methods.name: readIdentity
methods.description: Reads and decodes device identity data from a specified file.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Encodes and writes the device identity data to persistent storage.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates a new device identity with a fresh key pair and derives its device ID.

methods.name: deriveDeviceId
methods.description: Derives a device ID from a public key in Base64 format using SHA-256.

methods.name: sha256Hex
methods.description: Computes SHA-256 hash of input data and encodes it as a hexadecimal string.

methods.name: base64UrlEncode
methods.description: Encodes data into URL-safe Base64 format without padding.

methods.name: base64UrlDecode
methods.description: Decodes URL-safe Base64 strings into byte arrays, handling padding accordingly.
